title: Spec-answer question text can flag paths the owner did not choose

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261125-153915-ab03 for S560. `decisionPathsSection` (`internal/engine/decisionpaths.go:25`) scans `rec.Decisions` and every slice line that starts with `Owner decisions (` in full (`decisionpaths.go:27,44-45`). Those texts hold each question's title as well as the owner's answer. A path named only in a title, such as the placeholder `landed-changed/ID.md` in adj 404's title, is flagged as one the owner chose, and the reviewer sees a false omission.

Owner decision (adj 569, `spec.owner-decisions-format`, Jon, 2026-11-25): one line each. `RecordSpecAnswers` (`internal/engine/speccheck.go:821`) writes every `title -> answer [key].` on its own line. The check scans only the text after `->` on each line. A line with no `->` is still scanned whole. The paragraph splitters change to match.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestRecordSpecAnswersAppendsToTheImplementSection (`internal/engine/speccheck_test.go`, existing, updated): the returned paragraph and the `--text=` arg of the one `slicer edit S11 --section Implement --append` call both equal `"Owner decisions (2026-10-19):
Which store holds the index? -> memory: rebuilt at each start [cache.index-store].
What names the flag? -> --extra."`. The header is on its own line and each question gets one line. It fails today because the paragraph is a single line.
- TestDecisionPathsReviewerBrief (`internal/engine/decisionpaths_test.go`, existing, extended with new cases; the changed-paths value is `landed-changed/S548.md\x00` unless stated):
  - "spec question path ignored": `h.cfg.Decisions = "Owner decisions (2026-11-25):
Write landed-changed/ID.md? -> landed-changed/S548.md."`. No `## Decision changelog paths` section reaches the reviewer. Today `ID.md` is flagged.
  - "slice paragraph question path ignored": the slice's Why body holds `Owner decisions (2026-11-25):
Write landed-changed/ID.md? -> yes, edit landed-changed/S548.md.` (written as `\n` inside the JSON string). No section is produced. Today the second line is not even scanned, because it does not start with the prefix. After the fix it is scanned, and only its text after `->`.
  - "line without arrow scanned whole": decisions are `"Owner decisions (2026-11-25):
Note: edit landed-changed/S548.md."` with an empty changed-paths value. The section flags `landed-changed/S548.md`.
  - "answer paths still flagged": decisions are `"Owner decisions (2026-11-25):
Which entry? -> edit landed-changed/S548.md and landed-changed/S549.md."` with an empty changed-paths value. The section lists both paths, sorted.
  - The existing cases (spec, answer, number, key, paragraph, multiple, diff, adj) keep passing unchanged.
- TestOwnerDecisionKeyChecksReachBriefs (`internal/engine/brief_test.go`, existing, updated): `h.cfg.Decisions` becomes `"Unrelated [brief.outside].

Owner decisions (2026-11-25):
Always missing -> x [brief.missing].
Target -> y [brief.target].
Reused -> z [brief.reused, adj 7].

Other paragraph [brief.after]."`. Keys on every line of the owner paragraph are checked, and the keys outside it and the adj-id key are not. It guards the paragraph splitter against the multi-line form.
- TestSpecAnswerRecordsTheAnswersAndReleasesTheItem (`internal/daemon/speccheck_test.go`, existing, updated): the joined `slicer edit` args contain `"Which store holds the index? -> memory: rebuilt at each start [cache.index-store].
What names the flag? -> long: --extra."`. It fails today because the two entries share a line.
- TestAnsweredSpecQuestionsReachTheImplementerBrief (`internal/daemon/speccheck_test.go`, existing, updated): the implementer brief and the run record's `Decisions` contain the same two-line text as `want`.
- TestSingleRunCarriesSpecAnswersIntoTheBrief (`internal/daemon/speccheck_test.go`, existing, updated): `want` is `"Which store holds the index? -> memory [cache.index-store].
What names the flag? -> long."`. The brief, the returned record and the stored record contain it.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `internal/engine/speccheck.go`, change `RecordSpecAnswers` to write `Owner decisions (DATE):` as the first line. Then write one line for each question: `TITLE -> ANSWER`, then the ` [key]` or ` [key, adj N]` marker when the question has a key, then `.`. Lines join with `\n`, there is no blank line, and there is no trailing newline. Update the doc comment. Answers are already whitespace-normalised, so each stays on one line.
2. In `internal/engine/brief.go`, add `ownerDecisionParagraphs(text string) []string`. It splits `text` on blank lines (`\n` plus optional spaces, then `\n`) and returns the paragraphs whose trimmed start is `Owner decisions (`. Use it in `ownerDecisionBody` in place of the inline `strings.Split(text, "\n\n")` and prefix test. The key marker scan then covers every line of the paragraph. Behaviour for the old one-line paragraphs is unchanged.
3. In `internal/engine/decisionpaths.go`, add `ownerAnswerText(text string) string`. For each line of `text` it keeps the text after the first `->` when the line has one, and the whole line when it has none. It joins the results with `\n`.
4. In `decisionPathsSection`:
   - Pass `rec.Decisions` through `ownerAnswerText` before it goes into `texts`.
   - Replace the per-line `Owner decisions (` prefix scan of each section body with `ownerDecisionParagraphs(section.Body)`. Append `ownerAnswerText(paragraph)` for each paragraph.
   - Leave answered run questions (`q.Answer`) and the adj `Decision` and `Rationale` texts scanned whole.
   - A paragraph in the old one-line form skips only the first title. That is accepted for specs and run records written before this slice.
5. Update the tests named under Failing tests, and add the new `TestDecisionPathsReviewerBrief` cases.
6. In `docs/design.md`, at about line 358, say that each answer is its own line in the paragraph. In the `## Decision changelog paths` bullet (about line 2016), say that for owner decision paragraphs only the text after `->` on each line is scanned, and a line without `->` is scanned whole.
7. Record the changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S573 --text "..."` (never edit `CHANGELOG.md`).
